reviews.title: A powerful piece of equipment
reviews.comment: I ordered this GPU for my custom PC build. It was the first PC I ever built and I couldn't be happier with the quality and performance of the 4080 Super. My last GPU was a 1070, so this was like going from a beat up old sedan to a lambo.
reviews.author: Cameron Bottoms

reviews.title: Exceeded expectations
reviews.comment: Great card. I can play any game I want on my 4k monitor with no issues. Great investment
reviews.author: Kevin

reviews.title: Que potencia!
reviews.comment: Para cualquier juego es perfecto. Muy bonita estructura y muy buen producto
reviews.author: Kindle Customer

reviews.title: Defective fans in a month and a half
reviews.comment: Took about a month for one of the fans to start making noise , it seems it has a defective bearing . Customer service wait was over 20 minutes . Go with a different provider with a better product and customer service . 1000 bucks for a card with a defect is steep .
reviews.author: Andrew12
